description.value: SEAPARC is a municipal recreation complex operated by the Capital Regional District, serving Sooke and the Juan de Fuca Electoral Area. The facility includes a pool, ice arena, fitness centre, weight room, golf course, and the Sooke Bike Park—a dedicated cycling facility that makes it a relevant stop for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island's southwest coast. The complex also manages the Sooke Skate Park, currently being rebuilt as of late 2025.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms SEAPARC is an active municipal recreation complex in Sooke with pool, arena, fitness centre, weight room, golf course, and notably a Sooke Bike Park. The address (2168 Phillips Road, Sooke, BC V9Z 0Y3) and phone (250.642.8000) are confirmed on the website. OSM tags confirm wheelchair accessibility. No explicit mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, showers, food service, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities on the website pages provided, so these remain null despite being plausible for a facility of this type.

Most cyclist-relevant amenities (washrooms, showers, water, bike parking) are highly likely for a facility of this type but could not be confirmed from the website text provided.
